item.title: High school basketball finals moved to Monday
item.description: The Athletic Association of Brant, Haldimand and Norfolk boys basketball championships will now take place on Monday. Due to inclement weather for a second straight day, local schools were closed which forced the planned Thursday games to be moved to Monday. item.title: Councillor urges Norfolk to 'get realistic' about developing industrial land
item.description: There are about 255 hectares of usable industrial land in Norfolk, but most isn’t marketable or investment-ready because of servicing gaps, connectivity challenges and official plan designation constraints.

item.title: Icy roads close Grand Erie schools again Thursday
item.description: Schools in Brant, Haldimand and Norfolk counties and the city of Brantford remain closed on Thursday after bus service was cancelled due to icy road conditions.

item.title: County of Brant approves 5% residential property tax hike
item.description: County of Brant residential property owners will be paying five per cent more on their tax bills after council approved its 2026 budget. The tax hike includes a property tax increase of four per cent and a one-per-cent property tax surcharge as a local contribution toward the ‘New Hospital Project’, a commitment council has […]

item.title: St. Joseph's hospital in London publishes reviews after uproar over research on dogs
item.description: St. Joseph’s Health Care has released several third-party reviews that found the London hospital’s animal care was in compliance with provincial and national standards, despite backlash following reports that dogs were used in cardiac research by its research arm. item.title: Paris Titans heavy underdog in PJHL playoff series against Tavistock Braves
item.description: The Paris Titans will have their hands full this weekend as they enter the Provincial Junior Hockey League playoffs. Paris will open a best-of-seven South Doherty Division quarter-final playoff series in Tavistock on Friday against the Braves. item.title: Brant resident facing sex assault, criminal harassment charges
item.description: A 45-year-old Brant resident has been charged with two counts of assault – spousal in connection with an incident on Feb. 16.

item.title: Brantford International Villages Festival looking for more participants to showcase their culture
item.description: Organizers of the Brantford International Villages Festival are hoping to attract new participants to showcase the city’s growing culture and ethnic diversity.
